storyInfo: Sonya interrogates the hostage and obtains info on the headquarters of the 'Sixteen Warriors'. She works with Antosha to defeat Gromov, despite a heavy loss of life. However, they have a falling out after the battle over the treatment of the hostage.

attributes.content: Yeremey! You're still drinking? I had to turn the chemical factory upside down to find that single crate of beer!
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Get lost—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Heh, let him drink, he's had plenty of scares these past few days.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Well *hic*... I pulled through *hic*... lousy beer *hic*... totally beneath me *hic*...
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: O noble lord, what has brought you down so low, that you must beg a humble 'peasant' like me for drink?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: No, you're a decent fellow *hic*... the best *hic*...
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: I'm a 'peasant' too, Yeremey, compliment me!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Forget it—*hic*!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: How did we get onto this topic? It's kind of embarrassing, really.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Listen, friends, I'll buy you a crate of beer for every cup I drink here.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Sonya, Mykola, Fedya, there'll be plenty for everyone!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: You alright, Yeremey?
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Judging from the way he's chugging one beer after another, I'd say he's perfectly alright.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: How about you save the rest of the beer for us right now, because Fedya is sitting right behind you!
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Not *hic* Not tonight... after tonight, whatever you want *hic*—
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Why don't you sit with the others?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: What about you, the conquering hero who captured the enemy?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Sonya and Antosha have been interrogating him all day. We should know more soon.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Let's hope it'll bring about the end of Gromov's tyranny...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: You don't sound happy.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I've been thinking about what caused the radio blackout in the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: The Third Bureau has its ways.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But your equipment still caught my signal. How...?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: You ask too many questions, 'Botani'... 'bookworm', indeed.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: There aren't many earnest folk in Ursus these days... I can't believe I've become so nostalgic.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I know you're hiding something from us, Fedya.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: If you don't want to talk about it, I'll just pretend not to notice.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: But I couldn't have brought Baron Pavalo back without you... you're the true hero on that front.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Maybe one day, you'll be a hero to even more people...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Fedya! Botani! Want a drink?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Yeremey sure is strong when he's drunk. He won't let me near the booze.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Well, he's finally out cold now, and I punched him a couple of times for good measure. He's not waking up for a while.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Anyway, we've got enough for four cups. Want to sit down and chat a little? I'd love to make friends...
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Sure, Pencil Stub. I think this is the first time you've seen my face?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Hah, you scared people when you showed up covered in blood, but we all relaxed when we heard your voice.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Anyway, I've got your cups. This one's for you, Fedya.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: ...Spasibo.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: To tomorrow!
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: To victory!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: To...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: To souls happy and free.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I cannot accept this compromise.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Unless you got a better idea. You can torture him if you want, but the only thing he cares about is his own hide.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I warned you, Pavalo is the prototypical Ursine noble.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Short-sighted, cowardly, ever dreaming of kindness and 'guidance' from above, acting harmless while pocketing all the gold and silver.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Give them a chance to catch their breath, and they will not hesitate to draw their swords against the people, and offer bloodshed to their liege lords as a gift.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Walking corpses whose expertise is self-preservation... can you not smell their stench?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We can keep arguing, or we can spend our time making more urgent plans. The intel I extracted from him includes a map of the Sixteen Warriors headquarters.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: They've got lots of supplies there, and he says Gromov has been gone a lot lately. This is the perfect opportunity.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: He will sell you out, if he gets out alive... you'll have every policeman in Ursus on your tail, even if you manage to get out of Katorga. Do we really want to meet again in court?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: At least we share the common goal of liberating this raion right now. We can argue about the rest later.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Assaulting their headquarters is no easy task. We are willing to work with you, but we'll need to rest and regroup. Perhaps—
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Understood. Once we are all set, we will move out and have Pavlo lead the way.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What do you think, Antosha?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Bring plenty of guys, Sonya. Do not underestimate him.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: ...Sonya?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Shh. I don't want to wake them up.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I just wanted to... get some rest by the fire.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You've done a huge service for the people here. But I'm still not sure if I'm a leader worthy of any of that.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: When I got back to Ursus, I thought about living a normal life back home, but all of us are still struggling in the mud, me and all the girls who follow me...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I've let a lot of people down, watched my friends die... soon, I'll be leading them on another journey.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Can we go back to our old lives? Or am I just gonna fail at everything...?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You've already achieved a lot, haven't you?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: ...Huh?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You can have half my beer. I haven't touched it yet.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Zima reflexively takes the cup and inhales the faint scent of wheat, while faint snoring rings in her ears.
She scans the peaceful sleeping faces, red and puffy, smacking their lips in their dreams... it is the most peaceful night they have had since they came to the quarantine zone.
Hm...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Half a cup, even if it's just half a cup...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Boss, take it easy.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Guard

attributes.content: Where is Pavlovich? Spit it out!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Why did those mudaki take my cannons? Why did they cut the supplies? I want an explanation!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: The magistrate will be back soon. I'm sure it'll all sort itself out.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Guard

attributes.content: He gave us money, and those bodyguards he has—
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Guard

attributes.content: Blyat! I don't need you to tell me that! Pizdets!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: He picks up a chair and throws it into a corner, then hears a frail, frightened chirping.
...What's that?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Gromov lifts the velvet covering the box, revealing an elaborate cage and its resident, a brown beckbeast trembling in a corner.
Pavlovich's? He didn't take his stupid pet with him today...
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: You, wait outside.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Yes sir!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Guard

attributes.content: After his subordinate has left, Gromov grins, He will bring his arrogant employer down a peg.
Rough hands reach into the cage, put themselves around the poor little creature's neck, and twist...
Gromov! I didn't expect to see you here. I heard you were looking for me?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...Why are you staring at my beckbeast like that?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: What is it doing here...?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: We don't see each other for a few days, and you've already forgotten? How could I go without its companionship?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Uh...
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Feeling jealous? Hah, I knew you loved small animals too.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: There's another one in my office that's going to breed with this one. You can have one of the babies.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Where's your gratitude?
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Don't worry about it.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I don't suppose you came for this. What has you in such a hurry?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Gromov takes one look at the bodyguards, all of them bigger than him, and swallows the profanities that he had intended to say.
Why did you cut our supplies, sir? We're having enough trouble handling those kids as it is.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Do you remember why I hired you to manage Katorga Raion, Gromov? You were the lowest bidder.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I hope you have not forgotten this excellent quality.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Then my cannons—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Do not mention them again. I wouldn't tell you, even if I knew.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: This is noble business. Do your job!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Boss! We've got a problem!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Ruffian

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Th-The students found the 'Honor Room'!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Ruffian

attributes.content: Blyat! How's that possible?!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: I just came from there! Sonya is gonna get in, if we don't send help!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Ruffian

attributes.content: Magistrate!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Assign half our security team to him.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Yes sir!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: If anything goes wrong, I will feed your pieces to my beckbeast. You understand?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Now get lost!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...Exterior is clear. Cleaning up.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: These guys can fight, but they have absolutely no discipline.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Are things going well on the General's side? She should be inside their HQ by now.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: The Sixteen Warriors will fight tooth and nail to protect it. We need to get over there and back them up, fast.
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Let's hope Gromov has some real food here. I've had enough of cans—
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: His smile freezes on his face. He sways and falls by the feet of his friends. There is a crossbow bolt straight through his chest.
Yeremey's eyes widen. He sees Gromov approach with a dozen massive brutes in tow.
Hurry! Stop them!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Blyat!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Die, mudak!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: No!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Yeremey's steel pipe meets Yeremey's hamaxe, and he is sent flying like a balloon.
Yeremey! No!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Your turn, cherv.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Gromov...!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: You will pay for your crimes, murderer!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: I'll kill you or die trying!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Blood rushes up her throat, and she can speak no more.
With great effort, Nika turns her neck to look in Yeremey's direction. She sees her friends scrambling to form a line, while Gromov has already charged inside like a monster.
I knew it was a trap the moment you said you were going to bribe Gromov and get him to let us out.
But why did I go with you... Yeremey?
Govno, govno, govno!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: It's not over yet... We can cut through the back—it's faster. My men must still be fighting inside.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: I'm the only one who knows the passphrase to the Honor Room. I'll hand out the weapons inside and turn this around...
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: The door's just ahead—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: I got the last one, General!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: ...Gromov?!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: A brief silence, then Gromov leaps towards a machine on the wall.
Please speak the passphrase.
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: *Expletives*!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Passphrase incorrect.
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: Watch out! That button must be hiding something!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Matvey!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The bolt hits Gromov's left arm. He roars and manages to fend off his attackers by swinging his hamaxe.
Please speak the passphrase.
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: *Expletives*!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Passphrase incorrect.
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: *Ursine roar*!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Passphrase correct.
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: Welcome, brave Gromov, descendant of Igor Velikiy's sixteen bravest companions...
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: He whose will is unbreakable, heir to the unstoppable legendary hamaxe...
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: Before the recording can finish, Gromov has already charged through the facade, using the momentum to roll inside.
Leto's strike misses, destroying the annoying box instead.
*Bzz*... the Sixteen Warriors... usher... next golden age of Ursus!
attributes.name: Authentication Device

attributes.content: Who d'you think you are?!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Gromov tries to reach out, but a crossbow bolt hits the wall in front of him, just an inch from his finger.
I recognize you, and you... the Unbound.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: He jumps back and punches a brick on the wall, causing two transparent 'walls' to drop down between Gromov and the others.
I originally designed this 'prison' for Pavlovich. I never thought I'd be its first prisoner.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Did you think a single pane of glass would—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima punches the glass, only to be knocked back several steps.
Something's funny about this glass!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: The Third Bureau's shiny new toy, a new type of material that not even the tsar has seen... makes you wonder, doesn't it? Who did they make it for?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Better find yourself a landship if you want to break it... haha!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Gromov sits down on the floor, panting, but relaxed enough to begin tying his shoelaces.
We don't have much time... reinforcements will be here any moment. The guys outside can't hold for long.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: There must be a way!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The Sixteen Warriors... wait a minute!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Why are there two of the same hamaxes here in this room?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The sixteen heroes who fought alongside Igor Velikiy were the bravest and strongest warriors of their time...
The street thugs who took their name forged a hamaxe in imitation of the legendary weapon, only to find themselves unworthy, lacking the strength to lift the glorious weapon.
Therefore, Gromov put the 'authentic' weapon on display, and carries a replica.
You're crazy! No one can swing that thing!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: You'll only hurt yourself!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Sonya, do you need help—
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Botani's jaw drops as she watches Sonya smash the display glass and raise the hamaxe into the air. She can almost hear Sonya's bones creak at the stress.
Zima slowly walks towards the impregnable glass wall, dragging the hamaxe behind her.
No... no, no, no, no, no!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Looks like I'm more worthy than you...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Right?!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: This is for all the people you murdered, all the evil you've allowed, the judgment and punishment that you've dodged all this time... this is for pissing me off.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Any last words, Gromov?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: How—How could you possibly lift it—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: The words have hardly left his mouth before Zima brings the hamaxe down. In the brief moment that it takes to find its mark, Zima seems to feel it grow lighter in her hand.
No longer the stuff of legend, nor an artifact that should sit in a museum collecting dust, and certainly not the plaything of a murderer—
It is power.
The power to resist, to sweep aside obstacles, to cut open the path of life.
It has no opinion, no position, no intention, no emotion.
It is life's primal roar, the first drop of blood that the heart pumps with each beat. It ignores all the complicated things in this world. All it does is—
Fight!!!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya... we're saved.
attributes.name: Tired Student

attributes.content: The thugs ran for the upper walls once they saw Gromov's remains.
attributes.name: Tired Student

attributes.content: Good work... I know everyone fought bravely.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Do a head count, take as many supplies as you can, and the fallen—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya! Sonya! Over here!
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Keep your people in check!
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: She can't stop me. No one can.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Your Well Born death will make Ursus a better place, Baron.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What are you saying—help me!
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Calm down, Antosha!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: ...We had a deal, Antosha.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: He gives us the location, we spare his life.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I told you, Sonya, I will not suffer any of these leeches to live. Whatever value they might offer can only extend their lives for a few hours.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Allow them to live, and it will be our friends who die. It will be the workers in the mines, the farmers in the wilderness.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: At the moment of death, his pathetic life will offer its last worth, and atone for his sins.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: No. You're wrong.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: He only has value if he gets out alive. That'll tell the other opportunists like him that we can be reasoned with, that they can negotiate.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The empire isn't one big thing, it never was. This is how we'll trip them up, exploit their differences, and get what we want as fast and easy as we can.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: And my goal is to see all oppression gone from Ursus, from all of Terra.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I swore upon the future of this land that I will break its spine with my own hands and await a new dawn upon its ruins.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I do not kill these leeches for vengeance. I kill them so that this teetering house of cards will collapse more cleanly.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Killing a former noble who has already lost everything, begging for his life like a beckbeast...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You think a death like that means anything?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: All I know is that this is a country where the freedom of the wealthy is built upon the corpses of the poor.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Every one of them we kill is a life saved.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You're out to smash things, but you don't get that breaking stuff is just a means, not an end.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Rubble's not enough. We need unity. We need people, people who will stand with us and fight injustice when we need them most.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Really? Allowing a man like this to live is the greatest injustice to those he has exploited.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Enough, Sonya. Botani caught this man. It is your right to do with him as you please.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But, if you are willing to work with them, then this is where we part ways. The Unbound will work with you no longer.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Don't be stupid, Antosha!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're burning bridges, hurting your own cause, and putting the people who follow you in danger!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The Unbound don't follow me. I am simply their advisor.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: All of us have gathered here of our own volition, to act in every corner in Ursus where oppression exists, to help those who suffer fight back against the cruelty of the nobility.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Anyone is free to leave, if they don't agree with me. Anyone can remove me.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha turns around to seek Matvey's gaze.
This is a habit that he developed when they left school together, whenever he says something, goes somewhere, or kills someone.
Matvey always casts a supporting gaze from behind, helping him affirm that he is sober, and walking the right path.
Even Ukusik knows that Matvey will tell Antosha when he goes wrong.
But now—
There is no one there.
There you are, Matvey.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Matvey is standing in the snow. He takes a bloody cigarette and puts it in his mouth, only to cough violently at the acrid smoke.
...I never knew you smoked.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I never knew you killed for the sake of killing.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Some of them may be criminals who have yet to be judged. But they are not monsters doomed to be slain.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: You unleashed violence upon them, but allowed them to escape judgment... law and order have no place in your heart.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: ...You've told me that dozens of times. But there's no better way to uphold justice for the ordinary man. Unless you—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: No, Antosha.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: You are an aristocrat, and an Ursine. Every time I saw you kill someone, I couldn't help but wonder if they were actually men, just like you.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: But you never gave anyone else the same opportunity you had.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Matvey puts the burning cigarette in the snow, with the others that have fallen upon the white, soaked and crushed beneath the heels of passersby.
Then he turns around, walking the path from whence he came.
...I didn't kill Pavalo.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But Matvey is already far away.
Antosha... are you fighting with Matvey?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: No. Don't ask questions like this.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Then... can I go and see Rosalind tonight? She told me she'd tell me stories about her time in Kjerag after we beat Gromov.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: No, don't go there.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What about tomorrow?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Not tomorrow either, Ukusik. Don't go there anymore.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But aren't we gonna fight together to tear down that wall?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We will...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But Sonya has her path, and we have ours.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We will learn which is the right one.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: At any price.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What are you doing, Fedya?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: A head count, and preparing food for tomorrow.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Head count... how many did we lose?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: At least several. Possibly dozens. Some are still being treated.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I was happy that I finally did something that was absolutely right... but in the end—
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Things didn't seem to get better. We lost so many friends... and split with Antosha's group...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Did I really make things better for people, Fedya, like that voice from the Far North? Even just a little bit?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: You mean that criminal wanted for illegal broadcasting?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Yes. You did the right thing.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But I don't think you need me to judge what you've done.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Fyodor lights the campfire that has been out for a while.
He digs out a lonely potato lying in an ash heap, puts a wooden skewer through it, and begins to roast it.
Because what really matters isn't what I say... but how you view yourself.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Should I consider that a lecture?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: I don't know... maybe you're right. No. Maybe I'm right.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: That night, we sat together by the fireside and roasted potatoes just like this.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: That was the first time you joined the circle of students, chatting with them, talking politics, discussing literature...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: That was the first time I saw with my own eyes the people I only knew by voice.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: It was wonderful...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: ...Your efforts were never futile.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: I was the voice on the headset. I think I'll continue to be that.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Thanks, Fedya!
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: 'That night, we sat together by the fireside and roasted potatoes just like this...'
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Pencil Stub...

attributes.content: Fyodor's hands cannot stop trembling. The hands that gave the chervontsy to Shorty...
The hands that saved lives...
The hands that wrought countless deaths...
Fyodor cannot describe his feelings in words. He can feel his excitement, and genuine fear...
By the time Fyodor wakes from his reverie, the campfire has been reduced to a small lick of flame, trembling in the darkness.
One side of the potato is burnt, while the other side is still raw.
'Tomorrow will come'...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Such a simple prayer.
attributes.name: Fyodor
